integrity: Proof of infinite identities included; finite computational checks are independent diagnostics and are not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Dyadic-prefix frequencies only; gaps are gaps between consecutive positive-support indices. A support-equivalent Fibonacci run transform was known earlier; the newly asserted claim is the full gap spectrum and exact count/frequency laws. Unindexed prior coverage remains a risk. No general arbitrary-cutoff frequency theorem asserted.
title: Exact dyadic return-gap law for a periodic binomial-parity transform
